MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

4. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

5. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

7. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.

8. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

   C. Run with the tool

11. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
